proposed_widenings.name: on_area_overlap_window
proposed_widenings.justification: The dispel-darkness clause fires when Daylight's area spatially overlaps an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower. No existing OngoingTrigger variant covers spell-area-to-spell-area spatial interaction. The v4 window atoms (turn_start_window, on_creature_enters_area, post_action_window, etc.) are all creature-action or creature-movement scoped — none model continuous or one-shot spatial intersection between two spell areas.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeChoice<Attachment> in ongoing_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Daylight offers two mutually exclusive attachment modes chosen at cast time: (1) a 60-foot-radius Sphere originating from a point within range, or (2) a 60-foot Emanation originating from a targeted object that is not worn or carried. The ongoing_effect family carries a single Attachment field. No CastTimeChoice wrapper over Attachment exists in the surface; CastTimeEffectModeChoice only applies inside direct-phase effect bundles.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object.

notes: The emit_light atom covers the lighting effect cleanly (brightRadiusFeet=60, dimAdditionalFeet=60). The object Attachment kind with heldOrWorn=forbidden covers the object-targeting mode. The area Attachment with emanation shape covers the emanation geometry. Two genuine blockers prevent honest encoding: (1) no cast-time choice over the ongoing_effect attachment, and (2) no area-overlap trigger for the dispel-darkness mechanic. The dispel-darkness mechanic is core enough — a key combat use of Daylight against Darkness spells — that omitting it would produce a misleading trace. No Dhall/JSON/trace produced.
